messages:
Ethan B (IC): quick Q - stayed at Marriott Munich for 3 nights on a client trip. the hotel charged the room + an "incidentals" block on the company card at check-in, then posted a final folio that combines room + minibar + parking into one PDF. minibar was personal (soda), parking was reimbursable. how do I submit so Finance only pays the reimbursable items?

expense-bot: Tip: attach itemized folio and provide a short note separating personal charges. Missing itemization may trigger manual review.

Ava R (People Ops): short answer: we need an itemized folio showing line items. if the folio already lists each charge, submit the whole folio and add a note: "parking reimbursable; minibar personal." then add a separate expense line for the personal amount (negative) isnt supported, so finance will manually code it out.

Priya S (AP): if the final folio is not itemized, ask the hotel for an itemized invoice (they can reprint with line-level details and VAT ids). if the hotel only gives a single lump sum we can: a) accept the full charge on the company card and treat personal portion as a payroll deduction (employee preference), or b) employee can reimburse the company via bank transfer and we refund only the business portion. Please indicate which you prefer when you submit.

Ethan B (IC): the folio shows lines but minibar just says "POS - FOOD" without amounts per item. parking line has an amount. minibar line is 8.60 EUR total. i bought one soda for 82.50. can i just note it and we reconcile?

Priya S (AP): yes, attach the folio and add: "Minibar personal: 82.50 EUR; please deduct from reimbursement." also add proof if you have (photo of the item or receipt). Finance will either deduct from the reimbursed amount or request a small repayment.

Nina T (Manager): approved for parking and room. Ethans note is fine. Nina: "Approved - client meetings on 3/15-3/17"

Ava R (People Ops): process notes: - Use expense type "Lodging - Company Card" and upload folio. - In expense notes add the exact personal amount and reason. - For euro charges we convert using transaction date rate (we accept xe.com/google). paste the link. - If employee prefers deduction on payroll, include a signed statement in the expense form; otherwise Finance will send a small invoice for repayment.

Ethan B (IC): uploaded folio + photo of minibar can. set note and chose payroll deduction. thanks!
